notes:
The 2.0.0 release marks the formal completion of the development work that occurred during the past year within IEA Wind Task 55 REFWIND. The development targeted several weaknesses:

Support to aero-servo-hydro-elastic solvers
More rigorous definition of blade outer shape and blade inner structure
More rigorous documentation
Stronger software backend
Many thanks to the entire development team for the outstanding achievement.

Development work will not stop here and 14 issues remain open. These are however minor and will be targeted in 2.x.y releases in the coming weeks and months
